evidence.title: Shortap — Quick tap gestures for your MacBook
Shortap — Quick tap gestures for your MacBook

name: Shortap
summary: Mac app that runs actions or Apple Shortcuts when you tap the left or right side of a MacBook once, twice or three times.
description: Shortap turns taps on a MacBook into commands: six slots (left or right side, one to three taps) can each trigger one of 50+ built-in actions — screenshot, mute/unmute, play/pause, next track, flashlight, toggle Wi-Fi — or any Apple Shortcut. It requires macOS 14+ and a MacBook Pro with M1 Pro or newer, or MacBook Air M2 or newer. One-time payment from $5.
contains: six tap slots: left/right side x 1, 2 or 3 taps
50+ built-in actions plus any Apple Shortcut
requires macOS 14+ and Apple-silicon MacBook (Pro M1 Pro+, Air M2+)
